mapper.sql: id, username, password_hash, display_name, role, status, security_version, avatar_url, bio, region, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (id, username, password_hash, display_name, role, status, avatar_url, bio, region, last_login_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{username}, #{passwordHash}, #{displayName}, #{role}, #{status}, #{avatarUrl}, #{bio}, #{region}, #{lastLoginAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET display_name = #{displayName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, bio = #{bio}, region = #{region}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'

where.if: (username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR display_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
